raw:
@q query
  select ?p
  where all
    match
      relation "be open"
      role subject ?p
      role location "Ileanda"
      role time "Sunday"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be a pharmacy"
      role subject ?p
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end

@q2 query
  where match
    relation "need to go to"
    role subject "the user"
    role destination "Jibou"
    polarity affirmed
  end
